You Build a Real Digital Footprint

Your website, Google listing, maps pin, and search presence all pulling the same direction. You show up everywhere your customers are looking. That is what gets the phone ringing.

They Trust You Before You Say a Word

A professional site does the credibility work before the conversation starts. Your first call isn't about proving you're legit. It's about closing.

Build Me a Site That Captivates
Behind the Broom

I'm Not an Agency.
I'm Just a Dude.

Josh Vogel

Founder · Builder · Bunny-in-Chief

Me, my two Dobermans on the couch, and a laptop. That's the whole operation. No account managers. No junior devs. No one forwarding your email to someone else. You talk to me. You work with me. We build something great for your business together.

I joined the Army. Before that I was deep in high-end sales and competitive bodybuilding — two worlds that drill one lesson into you fast: results are the only thing that matter. The Army confirmed it in a different uniform.

After I got out I went back to sales. Earned a master's degree in workforce development and leadership from LSU. Now finishing my MBA — my second master's — at UT. Somewhere in between I needed a mental outlet, so I started learning to code. X posts. YouTube at midnight. One concept at a time until it all clicked.

What I found when I got good at it made me angry. Small businesses were getting completely left behind. Big agencies charging $10k, $15k, $25k for sites smaller businesses needed just as badly but couldn't afford. So they got nothing — or they got a Wix template and called it done.

I built The Dust Bunny to fix that.

Here's the analogy that says it better than anything else I've got.

Someone recommends a steakhouse. Best steak of your life, they say. You pull up the website and there's nothing there. A Facebook page from 2018 and a blurry photo of a ribeye.

You start doing the math. If this place is charging $400 for dinner and can't be bothered to put together a real website, do they actually believe in what they're serving? Or are they coasting and hoping nobody looks too hard?

That doubt is quiet. But it wins more often than you think.

You are that steakhouse to someone right now.

A real business. Real work. Real results. And somewhere out there, a person who needs exactly what you do just pulled up your site, got that quiet doubt, and called your competitor instead.

Be the standard. Make your competitors uncomfortable.
Make people pull up your site and think: yeah, these are the ones.

That is what we build.

Let's Build Yours
I Know What You're Thinking

Let Me Guess.

"It's too expensive."

You know what's expensive? Losing 40% of your revenue growth because you don't have a real site. A website from The Dust Bunny is not a cost. It is the highest-ROI thing most small businesses can spend money on. And you won't need a second mortgage to get one.

"I'll just use Wix."

Go ahead. Let me know how that works out. Template platforms look like template platforms. Customers can tell. They are SEO disasters dressed up with drag-and-drop convenience. Built to be easy, not to win. Custom sites load faster, rank higher, and convert better. Full stop.

"I need to think about it."

Here's what to think about: every day you wait is another 76 people in your area searching for what you do, finding someone else, and visiting their business within 24 hours. That is Google's own data. Thinking about it has a price. It is measured in customers who did not call you.

"My current site is fine."

Fine doesn't fill your pipeline. When did you last look at your site the way a new customer does? On a phone. Cold. No context. No loyalty. If it looks fine to you, it might be because you already know what it's supposed to say. They don't.
